description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git revision list filtering features. It contains numerous test cases verifying behavior of object filtering, filters by object type, size, sparse path/OID, and combination filters, as well as testing error conditions and protocol expansion.

methods.name: expect_has
methods.description: Verifies that a certain object hash and name appear in the list of objects.

methods.name: expect_has_with_different_name
methods.description: Verifies that specific objects appear with different names after filtering.

methods.name: expect_invalid_filter_spec
methods.description: Checks that invalid filter specifications fail with expected error messages.
